title: Calvin Harris, Subtronics & Illenium Will Make Their Tomorrowland Debuts This Summer: See the Lineup
summary: Tomorrowland returns to Boom, Belgium, in July.
contentText:
Tomorrowland has announced the lineup for its flagship edition in Boom, Belgium, this summer.

The always expansive lineup this year features the first ever Tomorrowland Belgium appearance by genre titan Calvin Harris, who is playing the festival after first appearing at a Tomorrowland in 2013, when he played the U.S. edition.

Subtronics and Illenium will be also playing Tomorrowland for the first time this year (Illenium was scheduled to play the 2020 festival, which was canceled due to the pandemic), with lineup highlights also including John Summit, Sara Landry, David Guetta, NERVO, Martin Garrix, Fisher, Miss Monique, Hardwell, Alesso, Laidback Luke, Indira Paganotto, Sebastian Ingrosso, Dimitri Vegas & Like Mike, Marlon Hoffstadt, Kevin de Vries, Lost Frequencies, Agents of Time, The Chainsmokers and many (many) more.

Tomorrowland happens at De Schorre recreation park on July 17-19 and July 24-26. A ticket pre-sale happens on Jan. 24, with the general on-sale happening Jan. 31.

The lineup announcement is the second major piece of news from Tomorrowland so far this year, with organizers announcing the debut Thai edition of the festival earlier this month. Tomorrowland Thailand will happen Dec. 11-13 at a 237-acre site in Wisdom Valley in Pattaya, Khao Mai Kaew, Bang Lamung District, Chonburi Province, with the lineup yet to be announced.

The Belgium event this summer will also mark a mighty return of the festival’s fantastical mainstage, a structure that in 2025 burned to the ground just days before the festival.
